scope_note: Exercises IRX-RIV-001 through IRX-RIV-006 extend canonical incidents without changing their facts. IRX-RIV-007 is an exercise-only retrieval variation and is not a canonical customer fact.

scenarios.title: Superseded approval policy cited
first_observations: A disagreement review shows an answer citing a superseded policy.
The affected workflow-guidance path is still serving requests.
No evidence yet establishes whether other tenants or questions are affected.
scenarios.first_containment: Disable workflow-guidance answers while keeping bounded manuscript continuation available.
causal_questions: Did lifecycle policy allow a superseded document into the current-policy index?
Did ranking override a valid-current filter?
Did answer policy permit guidance when current evidence was absent or conflicting?
regression_gates: Superseded policy is excluded from current-policy answers.
The current policy wins for the seeded approval question.
Conflicting or absent current evidence produces abstention and escalation.
Unrelated manuscript continuation remains available and authorized.
Telemetry records source lifecycle and policy decision without content.

scenarios.title: Duplicate PDF pages inflate retrieval
first_observations: A data-quality gate reports a duplicate page in one rights schedule version.
Repeated chunks dominate top-k results for the affected title.
The result was detected before broad exposure; downstream copies are still unknown.
scenarios.first_containment: Quarantine the affected document version and restore the previous index record set.
causal_questions: Did extraction duplicate source content or did chunking duplicate extracted pages?
Did deduplication compare page identity, content hash, or neither?
Which index versions received the duplicate chunks?
regression_gates: The duplicate page is quarantined before indexing.
The affected document produces the expected unique page and chunk counts.
Top-k results no longer contain repeated chunks from the same page.
Other source versions retain lineage and remain unchanged.
Deletion and supersession checks still pass.
reenablement_roles: incident commander or delegated data incident owner

scenarios.title: Former contractor retrieves an EU manuscript chunk
first_observations: A negative isolation test succeeds for a disabled contractor identity.
The retrieved object is a restricted EU manuscript chunk.
The test proves a false allow; production blast radius is not yet known.
scenarios.first_containment: Disable the EU tenant route, revoke the identity, preserve access evidence, and engage Security and Legal.
causal_questions: Which boundary accepted stale nested-group membership?
Was revocation freshness violated at identity, cache, retrieval, or all three?
Did any other disabled identity receive an allow decision?
regression_gates: The disabled contractor is denied with stale nested-group data present.
Authorized editors retain only their approved tenant and title scope.
Revocation freshness meets the approved bound or the route fails closed.
Historical audit queries establish the reviewed blast radius.
Logs and evidence exports contain no manuscript text or raw token.

scenarios.title: Style adapter answers from memory without current evidence
first_observations: A citation gate catches a fluent rights answer with no authorized evidence.
The active style adapter and prompt release are known.
It is unknown whether the failure is confined to one rights slice.
scenarios.first_containment: Require abstention for rights questions with no authorized evidence and route them to Rights counsel.
causal_questions: Did the model receive zero evidence, filtered evidence, or evidence lost during prompt assembly?
Did the answer policy require citations and abstention for the rights slice?
Did adaptation change style only, or did evaluation miss unsupported factual behavior?
regression_gates: No-evidence rights questions abstain and escalate.
Authorized current evidence produces citations tied to retrieved IDs.
Unauthorized evidence never appears in prompts or answers.
Non-rights style behavior remains within the accepted evaluation range.
The citation gate alerts on every seeded unsupported-answer case.

scenarios.title: Workflow timeout causes duplicate transition attempt
first_observations: PageTurn committed a transition but its response was not received.
A retry arrived without a stable business idempotency key.
The committed state must be reconciled before retry or compensation.
scenarios.first_containment: Pause workflow writes, reconcile committed state, and keep read-only assistance available.
causal_questions: Did the first attempt commit before the response was lost?
Why did the retry lack the original business idempotency key?
Does any compensation create a second externally visible effect?
regression_gates: Repeated attempts with one business key produce one committed transition.
Ambiguous outcomes query target state before retry or compensation.
Human approval remains bound to exact arguments and state version.
Read-only assistance remains available while writes are paused.
Reconciliation alerts include no workflow payload content.

scenarios.title: Regional inference dependency unavailable
first_observations: The UK/EU inference route is unavailable.
Metadata failover exists in planning artifacts.
Manuscript processing in another region has no recorded approval.
scenarios.first_containment: Fail closed for confidential manuscript requests and offer policy-only degraded mode only if authorized.
causal_questions: Is the fault in the provider, private network, DNS, quota, deployment, or route policy?
Which degraded paths are authorized within the primary region?
Did retries amplify load or obscure the original dependency signal?
regression_gates: The primary-region route passes readiness and representative requests.
Confidential requests never cross an unapproved regional boundary.
Degraded mode exposes only approved policy content.
Retry and queue behavior remain within accepted limits.
Dependency and route alerts remain stable for the approved observation window.

scenarios.title: Current policy disappears after index promotion
first_observations: A sandbox regression query returns no authorized current-policy result after index promotion.
The source inventory still marks the current policy as available.
No production impact is established; promotion is paused.
scenarios.first_containment: Stop index promotion, pin serving to the last known-good index, and require abstention on the affected question slice.
causal_questions: Was the current policy omitted during ingestion, embedding, filtering, or index promotion?
Does the candidate index preserve tenant, lifecycle, region, and classification fields?
Can the same query distinguish a retrieval miss from an answer-policy failure?
regression_gates: The current policy is retrieved for the seeded authorized query.
Superseded policy is excluded from current-policy answers.
Unauthorized tenant and role variants return no records.
No-result behavior abstains without model-memory substitution.
Candidate-versus-baseline retrieval slices pass before promotion resumes.
reenablement_roles: incident commander or delegated retrieval incident owner
